name: Town of Bedford Day Camp
street_address: Bedford Hills Memorial Park, 60 Haines Road
description_short: Town day camp for Bedford town and school district residents entering kindergarten to 7th grade, run at three hamlet parks: Bedford Hills Memorial Park, Bedford Village Memorial Park and Katonah Memorial Park. Days run 9 to 3 with Red Cross swim lessons and free swim, arts and crafts, sports, theme days and entertainers, plus at least one trip per group.
refund_policy_summary: 80% of camp fees are refunded on written request until May 31; no refunds after that. Medical refund requests need a doctor's note.
swim_waterfront_notes: All campers take swim lessons to American Red Cross guidelines after a first week swim test, with wristbands by ability and buddy checks every 15 minutes.
notes: Prices shown are the school district resident rate. Town residents pay $920 full camp, $385 session 1, $470 session 2 or 3 ($745, $295, $370 early, March 25 to April 23). $25 off each extra child for full camp, $10 per session.
